policy.mapped: One recommended Skill; alternatives are teacher choices, not a sequence.
policy.optional: No automatic replacement. Teacher chooses one if appropriate.
policy.retain: Retain existing guided practice; no Skill selected.
policy.preserve: You Do, Code First, all other phases, shared lesson scripts and scoring remain unchanged.
policy.readiness: Source-level curriculum mapping; individual Demo and browser readiness must be checked separately. Focus text is pedagogical guidance, not a claim of existing deep-link topic filtering.
policy.levels: Teacher chooses difficulty; no year-based default or requirement to complete all levels.
policy.special: Existing protected and legacy lesson formats remain untouched until separately agreed.
